description: This file contains the definition of the Validator class in the AWS SDK for PHP, responsible for schema validation of input data against constraints and shapes.

classes.name: Validator
classes.description: A class that validates a schema against a hash of input, enforcing constraints such as required fields, patterns, min/max lengths, and types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Validator with optional constraints.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates input data against a given shape, throwing exception if invalid.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches validation to specific check methods based on shape type.

methods.name: check_structure
methods.description: Checks shape of structure types, including required fields.

methods.name: check_list
methods.description: Validates list/array types against constraints.

methods.name: check_map
methods.description: Validates map/dictionary types.

methods.name: check_blob
methods.description: Validates blob data types, such as strings or resources.

methods.name: check_numeric
methods.description: Validates numeric types and their ranges.

methods.name: check_boolean
methods.description: Checks if the value is a boolean.

methods.name: check_string
methods.description: Validates string values and pattern matching.

methods.name: validateRange
methods.description: Validates that a value falls within min/max constraints.

methods.name: checkArray
methods.description: Checks if an array is indexed or associative.

methods.name: isAssociative
methods.description: Checks if an array is associative.

methods.name: isIndexed
methods.description: Checks if an array is indexed.

methods.name: checkCanString
methods.description: Checks if a value can be cast to string.

methods.name: checkAssociativeArray
methods.description: Validates whether an array is associative and consistent.

methods.name: checkDocumentType
methods.description: Validates a document type (e.g., array, scalar types).

methods.name: checkUnion
methods.description: Validates union types (exactly one non-null field).

methods.name: addError
methods.description: Records validation error messages.

methods.name: canJsonEncode
methods.description: Checks if data can be JSON encoded.
